newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai sets '97 sales at 85 trln won.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai sets '97 sales at 85 trln won.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Group said on Friday it has set a 1997 sales target at 85 trillion won, up from an estimated 74.4 trillion won this year.
"Hyundai's sales are expected to grow more than 10 percent next year despite the forecast of a slowing economy," said Kim Sang-nyung, a spokesman for the group.
"We will announce details of next year's business plans at a later date," he added.
Kim said the group plans to invest about 10 trillion won next year, the same as 1996.
Subsidiaries of the Hyundai Group include Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, South Korea's largest car maker, and Hyundai Heavy Industries Co Ltd, the country's largest shipbuilder.
